semiconductor_relevance: High — ATC Co., Ltd. provides critical components and systems essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: ATC Co., Ltd. specializes in supplying a wide range of materials, components, and equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include chemical and gas pressure vessels, gas purifiers, and vacuum components such as valves and feedthroughs, which are vital for maintaining purity and vacuum environments in semiconductor fabrication. The company also provides custom solutions to meet specific client needs in the semiconductor and chemical sectors.
